variants.hook: Where do lost socks actually go?
variants.first_line: Every wash, one sock disappears. Here is why.

variants.hook: Your washing machine is hiding something.
variants.first_line: Count your socks. Odd number, right?

variants.hook: Stop keeping the lonely sock just in case.
variants.first_line: You know the drawer I mean.

variants.hook: A tiny magnet ended my sock chaos.
variants.first_line: I did not believe it either.
